reasons: Every concrete claim traces to the three identical recordings. Inferences are marked and hedged honestly; the unknowns section is accurate and tells a weak model what not to assume. The chain is stepwise, verifiable by craftable, and scoped to this world. Remaining issues are cosmetic: the yields (1 log gives 4 planks, 2 planks give 4 sticks) and the practical consequence for leftovers are not in the lead; a small wording tightening in the description; the 'one oak_planks alone yields null' point could be made explicit as a warning that mid-build null is expected.
